comment: The checks main must require. The Dependabot auto-merge guard fails when a check listed here is not required
on main, or is required under another integration ID; extra required checks on main pass.
integration_id 15368 is GitHub Actions, so a check run of the same name from another app does not count.
Editing this list does not change the ruleset; only the owner changes that, in the GitHub UI.
scope: 'push' means the check runs on main commits and release
admission requires it green on the exact tagged SHA; 'pull_request'
means it only ever runs on PRs, so admission requires it green on
the head of the merged PR that produced the tagged commit (F02).
